timebase.declaredMeaning: UTC seconds since 1970-01-01; Page.ScreencastFrameMetadata timestamp is frame swap time
timebase.sourceClock: frame timestamp minus first genuine frame timestamp; browser performance epoch clock for actual marks/stop
timebase.duplicateFramesPolicy: Only actual screencast events saved; source encoding holds actual received frames until next real timestamp or observed stop clock.

frameAssetPolicy: Each originalSourceFrameName is a non-link provenance label. The851 frame records retain original index/time/hash/metadata; individual JPEG bytes are not in this evidence directory. Original media access is described separately by sourceVideoEvidencePath.

portableProvenance.observationScope: Actual current-candidate capture take-02; original source observations/ordinals/times, not final edited MP4 verification
transformations: Only artifact references/locator field names are transformed. Original native/model/UI/state/clock observations, recorded counts, capture errors and original JPEG/video hashes are retained; raw JPEG images are not copied.
